<a id="page-codes"></a>

## About this page

How one-time codes look on the Codes page and on an item's page, and whether they stay covered until you want one.

#### How it works

**Display** changes how each code is drawn and the order of the Codes page. **Privacy** keeps codes covered until you ask for one.

See also [Codes screen](/guide/screens/#screen-codes), [One-time codes](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-codes).

<a id="setting-code-size"></a>

## Size

How large codes are drawn on the Codes page.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Small | More codes fit at once. |
| Normal | The usual size. |
| Large | Easier to read from a distance. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

<a id="setting-code-groups"></a>

## Split in two groups

Shows 123 456 rather than 123456, which is easier to read and type.

#### How it works

Eight-digit codes split as 1234 5678. Copying always gives the digits without the space.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

<a id="setting-code-next"></a>

## Show the next code

In the last ten seconds of a code, shows the one that comes after it underneath.

#### Why it is there

A code about to change can run out before you finish typing it. With the next one in view, you can type that instead.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

A code that changes only when you ask for a new one has no next code to show.

See also [Time ring](/guide/settings/codes/#setting-code-ring).

<a id="setting-code-ring"></a>

## Time ring

A small ring beside each code that empties as its time runs out.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

A code that changes only when you ask for a new one has no ring.

See also [Show the next code](/guide/settings/codes/#setting-code-next).

<a id="setting-code-sort"></a>

## Order

The order of the codes on the Codes page.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| As in the vault | The order the vault holds them in. |
| By name | A to Z by the service that issued the code, or by the item's name when it does not say. |

<a id="setting-code-hidden"></a>

## Hide codes until clicked

Covers every code on the Codes page with dots. A click shows that code for 15 seconds and copies it.

#### Why it is there

On a shared screen, or with someone beside you, a code on show can be read and used before it changes.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

An item's own page still shows its code.

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Hide codes until tapped.

Covers every code on the Codes page with dots. A tap shows that code for 15 seconds and copies it.

See also [Block screenshots](/guide/settings/security/#setting-screen-protection).
